items.title: From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
items.claim: The abstract proposes decision-focused fine-tuning but omits whether it outperforms post-hoc thresholding.

items.title: Validating Mortgage Default Models Through a Regime Change: Evidence from 10.8 Million Freddie Mac Loans, 2020 to 2026
items.claim: An ensemble of logistic regression and gradient boosting achieved 0.815 out-of-time AUC, beating logistic regression alone.
